author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಂಕುರವು ಅಡೆತಡೆಯ ಮೆಟ್ಟುತಲೆ ಬೆಳೆವಂತೆ
ಮಂಕುಗಳ ಬದಿಸರಿಸಿ ಹೊಸಬೆಳಕ ಕಾಣು
ಬಿಂಕವನು ಬಿಟ್ಟುನಡೆ ಮಾನವತೆ ಬೆಳಗಿಸಲು
ಕಂಕಣವ ತೊಟ್ಟುನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As a sprout grows by pushing past obstacles,
push aside dullness and see a new light;
drop your vanity and walk on to make humanity shine;
tie on the sacred thread of resolve, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Like a seedling breaking through soil, break through dullness toward new light. Put pride aside and commit, as with a kaṅkaṇa (a vow-thread tied on the wrist), to serving humanity.
